# B2B 软件：SEO 与 AI 搜索获客案例

- 作者：Jake Ward（@jakezward）
- 发布时间：2026-10-26 21:27（北京时间）
- 原帖：https://x.com/jakezward/status/2114710386931048713
- 说明：以下为原帖中文全文翻译，后附英文原文；文中数据和效果为作者表述，未经独立验证。

---

## 中文全文

现在，连市值超过 1,000 亿美元的公司也在用 AI 搜索寻找和购买软件。

（最近就有一家通过 Claude 找到我们的客户，并签下了一份六位数金额的合同。）

下面是他们在开展 SEO 和 AI 搜索工作仅 3 个月后，如何赢得这类交易的：

- 梳理了 1,152 个与商业目标相关的主题，分析 10,000 多条 Google 搜索结果和 18,000 多次 AI 引用，弄清买家究竟在哪里搜索，以及哪些品牌正在占据优势。
- 反向研究了在 Google 和 AI 搜索中占据优势的竞争对手，包括他们获得排名的页面、内容形式，以及影响 AI 推荐的第三方来源。
- 修复了那些枯燥的 SEO 基础问题，例如失效页面、规范网址（canonical）问题、内容重叠和内部链接。
- 围绕买家实际搜索的内容开始建设内容：对比、替代方案、价格、集成、迁移指南和商业落地页。
- 建立追踪系统，监测 Google 排名、AI 推荐，以及哪些来源正在影响回答。

早期结果看起来不错：

- AI 可见度：47%
- 自然搜索点击量：增长 22%
- 企业客户线索：增长 29%

有意思的是，我们并没有使用任何神奇的 AEO 诀窍，只是做了大量研究、做好 SEO，并确保客户出现在买家寻找答案的各个地方。

如果一家市值超过 1,000 亿美元的公司正在使用 Claude 寻找软件，我认为这说明了 B2B 营销未来的发展方向。

买家并不在乎自己是通过 Google 还是 AI 找到你。

他们只想找到正确的解决方案，而你的工作就是确保他们找到你。

## 英文原文

Even $100B+ companies are using AI search to find and buy software now.

(one just found our client through CLAUDE and signed a 6-figure contract)

Here's how they're winning deals like this after just 3 months of SEO + AI search:

> Mapped 1,152 commercially relevant topics, analysing 10,000+ Google results and 18,000+ AI citations to understand exactly where buyers are searching and who's winning

> Reverse-engineered the competitors dominating Google and AI search, including their ranking pages, content formats and third-party sources influencing AI recommendations

> Fixed all the boring SEO stuff like broken pages, canonical issues, overlapping content and internal linking

> Started building content around what buyers actually search for: comparisons, alternatives, pricing, integrations, migration guides and commercial landing pages

> Built a tracking system to monitor Google rankings, AI recommendations and which sources are influencing the answers

Early results are looking positive:

AI visibility: 47%
Organic clicks: +22%
Enterprise leads: +29%

Funny thing is we haven't done any magical AEO hacks, just a ton of research, good SEO and making sure our client shows up wherever buyers are looking.

And if a $100B+ company is using Claude to find software, I think that tells you something about where B2B marketing is heading.

Your buyers don't care whether they find you through Google or AI.

They just want to find the right solution and your job is to make sure they find YOU.
